args.title: Fix error toast accessibility and persistence in Toast.tsx
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Update the Toast component so that error toasts use an assertive live region and do not auto-dismiss after five seconds, unlike info or success toasts.

label: bug
file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Error toasts should use an assertive live region and remain visible until explicitly dismissed, rather than using polite live regions and auto-dismissing after five seconds.
